name: My Otome Life
source:
"You're in an otome."

"A what-ta-me?"

You play a young high school student who plays one of these romantic visual novels for the first time... only to have the three love interests come to life! 

How will Dane, Caspian and Joel deal with the real world, now that they're out? And how will you deal with them turning your life upside down even as they try to win your heart?

[Edited from [url=https://tangodreamgames.itch.io/my-otome-life]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你进到乙女游戏里啦。”

“啥？什么‘一女’游戏？”

你将扮演一名高中生，人生头一回尝试玩这种恋爱视觉小说……谁知游戏里的三位可攻略男主角竟然活生生地从屏幕里走了出来！

如今来到现实世界的戴恩、卡斯皮安和乔尔将如何适应这一切？而面对一边把你的生活搅得天翻地覆、一边又使出浑身解数争夺你芳心的三人，你又该如何招架？

[摘自[url=https://tangodreamgames.itch.io/my-otome-life]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
